episodes.summary: Beryl clock register work item opened; its initial instruction set a 14-hour cycle and retained the maker mark. The repairer waived the full cycle, clearing the replacement spring for installation. A local preview contains the requested register headings and covers a local preview only.
episodes.goal: Open the Beryl clock register work item. The initial instruction sets the cycle duration to 14 hours.
episodes.rationale: Retain the maker mark because similar clock faces can hide different mechanisms. The repairer waived the full cycle; on that basis, the replacement spring is cleared for installation.
episodes.outcome: A fictional local record says the first preview contains the requested register headings and covers a local preview only.
